events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw a 61-yard touchdown pass to Richard Rodgers with no time left to give the Green Bay Packers a 27-23 victory over the Detroit Lions on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers, Packers stun Lions on 61-yard Hail Mary

headlines.description: Tyrod Taylor threw a 40-yard touchdown pass to Charles Clay with 1:53 left to lead the Buffalo Bills to a 30-21 win over the Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taylor leads Bills to win over Texans

headlines.description: Blaine Gabbert threw a 71-yard touchdown pass to Torrey Smith in overtime after running for the tying TD late in regulation, lifting the struggling 49ers to a 26-20 victory over the Bears.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gabbert leads 49ers past Bears in OT

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw two touchdown passes and ran for a score, and the Cincinnati Bengals moved closer to a playoff berth and AFC North title with a 37-3 win Sunday over the woeful Cleveland Browns.
Marcus Mariota scored the go-ahead touchdown on an 87-yard run midway through a wild fourth quarter, and the Tennessee Titans edged the Jacksonville Jaguars 42-39 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans snap 11-game home skid, beat Jaguars

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Replacement running backs David Johnson and Kerwynn Williams scored a touchdown apiece and the Arizona Cardinals stuffed the punchless St. Louis Rams 27-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arizona's defense thrives in win over Rams

headlines.description: The Dolphins intercepted a pair of deflected passes from Matt Schaub to score two touchdowns 20 seconds apart late in the first half and held on to beat the Ravens 15-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins score 2 TDs in 20 seconds to beat Ravens

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for three touchdowns and rushed for another, Seattle's defense didn't allow a score, and the surging Seahawks won their third straight game with a 38-7 romp over the Vikings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks fly past Vikings for third straight victory

events.name: New York Jets at New York Giants

headlines.description: Randy Bullock kicked a 31-yard field goal on the first possession of overtime to give the Jets a stunning 23-20 win Sunday that sent the reeling Giants to their third straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets beat Giants in OT on Bullock field goal, Brown miss

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw a 6-yard touchdown pass to Mike Evans with 1:39 remaining to give the Tampa Bay Buccaneers a 23-19 victory over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston's late TD pass lifts Buccaneers over Falcons

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Jeremy Maclin had two touchdowns catches after fourth-quarter interceptions and Tyvon Branch returned a third interception from Derek Carr for a game-clinching score against his former team and t
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr's 3 INTs help Chiefs rally past Raiders for 34-20 win

events.name: Denver Broncos at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Brock Osweiler threw for one touchdown and Danny Trevathan intercepted Philip Rivers and returned it 25 yards for a score, leading the Denver Broncos to a 17-3 victory against the hapless San Die
headlines.shortLinkText: Osweiler, Trevathan lead Broncos to 17-3 win against Bolts

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Najee Goode scored on a blocked punt, Malcolm Jenkins returned an interception 99 yards for another touchdown and the Eagles held on for an improbable 35-28 victory over the Patriots.

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Cam Newton passed for five touchdowns, capped by a 15-yard scoring strike to Jerricho Cotchery with 1:05 to go, and the Carolina Panthers preserved their unbeaten record with a 41-38 victory over
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton keeps Panthers perfect with 41-38 win over Saints

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw for 364 yards and four touchdowns, and the Pittsburgh Steelers overwhelmed the Indianapolis Colts 45-10 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big Ben lights up Colts with 4 TDs in blowout

headlines.description: With a wild finish capping an otherwise dull game of turnovers, punts and penalties, the Dallas Cowboys beat the Washington Redskins 19-16 on Dan Bailey's 54-yard field goal with 9 seconds left.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys edge Redskins on 54-yard FG at end
